In May 2022, officers responded to a disorderly female at a restaurant in Wyandotte, MI. They later located her intoxicated in a park, clearly presenting a danger. Despite suggestions to call an Uber, she demanded that officers drive her. Her disruptive conduct drew the attention of many, and she was eventually taken to jail. When placed in a cell for detox, her behavior escalated to outrageous levels.
